items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Klin is playing with both hands at the same — klin-klin-ke-la, Klin-ke-la, Klin-ke-la, Klin-ke-la. I just did ergun and that’s the way I teach.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. So I use that a lot key-la, key-la. Klin is playing with both hands at the same — klin-klin-ke-la, Klin-ke-la, Klin-ke-la, Klin-ke-la. I just did ergun and that’s the way I teach. That’s the standard way to teach it. Yes. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
It seems — I think I told you yesterday that most musicians in this country can get through a lifetime of gigs and their Latin repertoire consists of “Girl from Ipanema.”
